items.title: Raxio builds Mozambique’s digital infrastructure ecosystem
items.summary: Emídio Amadebai, country manager for Mozambique of Raxio, talks to The Energy Year about the impact of new data regulations on demand for digital infrastructure, the development of Mozambique’s cloud and connectivity ecosystem and opportunities arising from LNG and AI. Mozambique’s digital ecosystem is becoming more established. New regulations and growing demand from financial institutions,… Source
